findings.title: Per-answer Markdown caps do not bound the complete conversation draw
findings.trigger: Open a valid long session containing hundreds of completed answers of 64 KiB each. Core permits 1,000 requests and 2 MiB per response.
findings.behavior: conversation() clones the complete Session and ScrollArea::show executes every request. The formatting cache of 16 documents / 4 MiB does not bound this loop, and every uncached answer still builds source text widgets for up to 64 KiB.
findings.impact: Large valid histories can impose substantial allocation/text-layout work on each UI pass, despite bounded parser/cache/per-answer rendering. This is an inherited integration gap, not a new parsing regression or an observed timing claim.
findings.suggested_correction: Use an explicit bounded conversation page/visible-turn window with access to earlier answers, and avoid cloning the full Session during draw.
findings.producer_acknowledgement: desktop agrees aggregate traversal/full Session clone remain, and scopes claims to per-answer/cache limits

resolution.summary: conversation draw borrows Session, renders <=16 pre-indexed request/answer refs and scopes formatting to that range; toolbar clones ID/status only. Older/Later/Latest navigation retains access and exact whole-response copy, preserves an older request anchor during appended streaming work, resets safely on missing anchors, changed session, or same-ID shrink to <=16. Page-only navigation schedules formatting in application logic.

findings.title: A rewritten streamed link can reuse the previous accessibility action target
findings.trigger: Render a same-request stream containing [same](https://example.test/old), retain its AccessKit link target, rewrite the stream to [same](https://example.test/new) and render the new parsed revision, then deliver Click to the retained target.
findings.behavior: Previews assigns a new text_revision and correctly discards stale parsed results, but the document Ui ID binds only session/request/context. The native Link uses its structural slot ID, so the retained click may open the new URL instead of being ignored.
findings.impact: A user activation can be applied to a different link target than the immutable text revision that exposed it. HTTP(S) validation remains intact; this is an activation identity issue, not parser result isolation.
findings.suggested_correction: Bind interactive rendered document/link IDs to the immutable text revision, and regress old AccessKit click suppression after same-length rewrite. Whole-response copy may remain session/request/latest-source by its documented semantics.
findings.parent_acknowledgement: Parent agreed material identity bug and assigned desktop correction.

resolution.summary: Matched preview exposes its immutable text_revision. The app passes it as RenderOptions.link_revision. The renderer assigns each safe link an explicit Ui ID containing document identity, text revision and link ordinal. Old links cannot be reused by another same-request parsed revision. Whole-response Copy retains session/request identity and intentionally copies the latest source.
regression_assertions: Old and new source lengths are equal; link labels are unchanged.
The new immutable preview revision is greater than the old revision.
Clicking the old AccessKit link target produces no OpenUrl command.
The new link target differs and clicking it opens only https://example.test/new.
The original whole-response Copy target remains valid and copies the complete new source.

reviewed_properties.worker_ownership_and_cancellation: One background parser thread, one replaceable pending job, one completion slot and one immutable worker cache. Generation checks retire cancelled/superseded work at parse and publish boundaries. Join happens during shutdown outside UI draw.
reviewed_properties.preview_identity: Session, request, context and text revision plus exact source-string equality; same-length rewrites create a new revision and remove old ready content. Session/context/cancel transitions cannot publish retired content.
reviewed_properties.render_bounds: At most 16 indexed replies reach conversation layout. Selected preview sources cap at 16 documents and 4 MiB total source. Parser caps source at 2 MiB, events at 100,000, nodes at 25,000, depth at 32 and owned text at 4 MiB. Each formatted answer renders at most 2,048 nodes and 256 KiB text; source fallback previews at most 64 KiB. These are static source bounds, not measured latency claims.
reviewed_properties.history_access_and_copy: Earlier/Later/Latest pages keep every stored reply reachable, retain an older request anchor during arrivals and reset safely for missing anchors/session changes/same-ID short restores. Whole-response Copy reads complete exact current source; code copy uses original code text. Native selectable labels remain available for visible text.
reviewed_properties.resource_and_url_policy: HTML is literal text and images are alt text only. HTTP(S) targets are validated, absolute, credential-free and control/whitespace-free. Host receives a typed Open action only after activation; no automatic fetch, image load or URL open.
reviewed_properties.accessibility: Structural native list/list-item/heading roles, accessible link labels/actions and selectable text children were inspected. Rendered link activation is revision-bound, while whole-response Copy intentionally has stable latest-source identity.
reviewed_properties.draw_boundary: Markdown parsing stays in the parser worker; synchronization, exact-text identity checks and scheduling run in application logic. Conversation draw consumes immutable documents or bounded current-source fallbacks. No Markdown parse or whole-source hash is introduced in answer draw.
reviewed_properties.notes: The preview coordinator does not mutate notes. The notes edit buffer and 500 ms autosave/acknowledgement flow remain separate and unchanged.
reviewed_properties.dependencies_and_notices: Pinned pulldown-cmark 0.13.6 with default features disabled and url 2.5.8; the retained pulldown-cmark, unicase and url license notices match cached upstream bytes.

limitations: This is source-only evidence. No independently executed native rendering, screen-reader integration, physical geometry, pixel fidelity, timing, capture or reference parity is established.
The producer ran the listed headless tests; this reviewer inspected their source and retained logs without rerunning them.
Long histories use explicit 16-reply paging, not continuous virtualization. This is a documented long-history fidelity gap; full older-source access and copy remain available.
The separate inherited transcript/notes detail screen still clones a Session. The conversation correction does not establish global application memory or performance bounds.
Selection may reset when its endpoint leaves the view or when streaming text structure changes; the full-response copy action preserves complete-source access.
Existing failed ASR/model reports and corpus acquisition artifacts are outside this review and remain unchanged.
claim: No unresolved material source defect found in the held reviewed scope after the two corrections; implementation source review does not establish reference parity.
